title: R1 Neo: LoRa radio (SX1262)
description: Validate SX1262 radio on R1 Neo. Radio is modeled in DTS but enabled only by app overlays. Verify radio reset GPIO, SPI bus, DIO1 interrupt, and TCXO control. Test TX/RX at SF10/125kHz.
close_reason: Blocked: hardware validation task - requires physical R1 Neo device to verify GPIO/SPI/DIO1/TCXO and test TX/RX. Firmware config is complete (DTS models all pins, overlay enables radio). Needs lab validation.
